title: Mathematical novelty of the genus-saturation force-carrier derivation
html: Remark. The Diophantine constraint (m-1)(n-1)=2g enforces genus-saturation on the symplectic homology of Bring's surface. This algebraic geometry condition determines the force-carrier pair (knots with 9 and 10 crossings). It eliminates the need for auxiliary symmetry assumptions.
